SYSTEM reproducibility/clock-semantics observations could be over-read as mechanism or novelty evidence unless claim-type separation remains enforced.

false_negative_risks: Do not force a MECHANISM object merely to move the rolling share above 1/3; a fresh specifically justified no-target no-op is preferable when all available targets are incoherent, duplicative, MAIN-colliding, terminal, or reduction-by-construction.
Do not convert the existence of two no-target opportunities into a universal exception-rate cutoff; n=2 does not calibrate a numeric threshold.
Do not suppress bounded SYSTEM architecture/reproducibility work when no comparable executable/informative MECHANISM exists.
Do not require positive signal or prior comparator/reduction victory merely to become preformal_eligible or READY.
